name: com.99bugs.procanim
description: Procedural motion system for static (unrigged) models: data-driven motion states (idle, walk, run, flee, stalk, eat, drink, alert, die) with blending, spring-driven turn lean and start/stop settle, and a spawn pop. Replaces Unity's Animator for EcoBalance animals. No dependency on the EcoBalance app or EcoSim.
